req.title: Basic-auth requires both segments
req.statement: The system shall route /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> only when both user and passwd segments are provided.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must route only when BOTH path segments are present. Tests cover: (1) positive path with valid credentials matching both segments returning 200 + correct JSON, (2) negative path with wrong credentials returning 401, (3) boundary case with missing one segment returning 404, (4) decision-table covering all combinations of credential correctness, (5) negative path with empty-string-like segments that still satisfy routing but fail auth, (6) boundary with correct user but wrong passwd to catch boolean short-circuit mutations in check_basic_auth.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200_with_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Both user and passwd path segments are provided
Authorization header matches the path segments
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/alice/secret with correct Basic auth header
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'alice:secret').decode('ascii')
r = client.get('/basic-auth/alice/secret',
               headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'alice'

    assert data['user'] == 'alice'

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Both path segments provided with distinct values
Authorization header matches exactly
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/bob/p4ssw0rd with matching Basic auth
Assert response user field equals 'bob' not 'alice' or any other value
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_user_field_in_response_matches_path_segment():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'bob:p4ssw0rd').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/bob/p4ssw0rd',
                   headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'bob'
    assert data['user'] != 'alice'
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'authenticated', 'user'}

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_user_wrong_passwd_vs_correct_both
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Decision table: (correct user, wrong passwd) must differ from (correct user, correct passwd)
actions: Send request with correct user + wrong passwd -> expect 401
Send request with correct user + correct passwd -> expect 200
Verify the two responses differ in status code
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_correct_user_wrong_passwd_vs_correct_both():
    client = app.test_client()
    bad_creds = base64.b64encode(b'carol:badpass').decode('ascii')
    r_bad = client.get('/basic-auth/carol/goodpass',
                       headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {bad_creds}'})
    assert r_bad.status_code == 401

    good_creds = base64.b64encode(b'carol:goodpass').decode('ascii')
    r_good = client.get('/basic-auth/carol/goodpass',
                        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {good_creds}'})
    assert r_good.status_code == 200
    data = r_good.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'carol'
